Beginning analysis of the Markdown processing interface to identify its concrete implementations, runtime constructors, and component holders.

Searching the codebase for the Markdown service interface and its concrete implementations.

Reading v1.go to find exact construction with options. Checking whether the memopayload runner is wired in production.

The interface is `markdown.Service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. The concrete implementation is `*service`, created by `markdown.NewService`. `renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer` is used internally for rendering and renaming tags, but it does not implement the Service interface.

Checking whether other implementations of markdown.Service exist beyond test mocks.

The concrete implementation is the unexported `*service` struct in `markdown.go`. It is constructed by `NewAPIV1Service` in `v1.go` using `WithTagExtension` and `WithMentionExtension`. `RebuildMemoPayload` receives the interface directly from `APIV1Service`. `memopayload.Runner` holds the interface but is not wired into server startup.

RSSService also holds the interface field, receiving it from APIV1Service in server.go. RebuildMemoPayload accepts markdown.Service as a parameter without holding it.

The only concrete implementation of `markdown.Service` is the unexported `service` struct.

`*service` is constructed by `markdown.NewService` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` holds the interface and invokes it through `NewAPIV1Service`.

`RSSService` in `server/router/api/v1/rss.go` also holds the interface, receiving the same instance from `server.go`.

`memopayload.Runner` carries the interface field, yet it is not constructed in production; `RebuildMemoPayload` instead receives the interface directly from `APIV1Service`.
